prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable isolated foreground prop for AshenSpire, on genuine transparent alpha background. Polished hand-painted dark fantasy, weathered tactile surfaces, dark iron, aged brass and restrained ember-warm highlights, same painted language as the reference. Full object visible with generous transparent margins; no hard rectangular backing, background scenery, opaque backdrop, fake checkerboard, labels, lettering, UI, borders, logos, stat values, map coordinates or characters. Maintain clear silhouette readable on mobile. Do not add unrelated props.
Primary request: A slim vertical cluster of three weathered wrought-iron hanging chains of unequal lengths, each ending in a practical forged curved hook. Deep soot-black worn iron with restrained old bronze highlights, mechanically believable connected oval links and hook attachment rings. Top ends fully visible with attachment loops; all three hooks visible without overlapping into unreadable mass. Strong separated silhouettes. Entire object fits a tall portrait transparent canvas with clear margins. Used as quiet dungeon/forge menu edge dressing. No ceiling, wall, flame, banner, weapon, human or symbol.
